headlines.title: Vineyard Wind, GE Vernova end legal conflict over Massachusetts wind farm
headlines.summary: The settlement ends legal claims and allows the Vineyard Wind 1 offshore wind farm to continue full-scale operations.

headlines.title: GE Vernova and Vineyard Wind Settle $300M-Plus Offshore Wind Dispute
headlines.summary: The settlement ends a months-long dispute over payments, turbine problems and GE Vernova’s threatened exit from Vineyard Wind.

headlines.title: Why GE Vernova Stock Crushed it on Wednesday
headlines.summary: There was notable progress in a Texas power plant project that the company will supply.

headlines.title: GE Vernova (GEV) Stock Is Up, What You Need To Know
headlines.summary: Shares of energy transition company GE Vernova (NYSE:GEV) jumped 4.5% in the afternoon session after the company projected strong backlog growth at the Morgan Stanley Laguna Conference, estimating its total order backlog will surpass $200 billion in early 2027.

headlines.title: GEV Stock Jumps After GE Vernova CEO Touts This Milestone
headlines.summary: Despite widespread AI concerns, GE Vernova expects to reach a key backlog target sooner than expected. GEV stock jumped on Wednesday. At a Morgan Stanley conference, GE Vernova CEO Scott Strazik reportedly said the company's backlog, which ended the second quarter at $176 billion, is on track to hit $200 billion "very early" in 2027.

description: GE Vernova Inc., an energy company, engages in the provision of various products and services that generate, transfer, orchestrate, convert, and store electricity in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment designs, manufactures, and services gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies. It serves industrial, government, and other customers. The Wind segment offers wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment provides grid solutions; power conversion; electrification software; and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
